whatsNew:
• Global Localization Architecture: English is now the base default language across all screens, buttons, and settings; automatically uses Thai if the vehicle's system locale is Thai.
• BYD Dolphin Black Screen Auto-Resolution: Dynamic AVM camera detection (ID 0 vs ID 1 fallback), dead-slot frame watchdog, and manual AVM Camera ID selector in System Settings.
• Expanded Camera Persistent View: Single tap or '+ Right / + Left' expands camera and stays persistent on screen until closed via double-tap.
• Front Wheels Sub-Automations: Exit Park, steering angle threshold, and speed limit cutoff work independently of the turn-signal wheel attachment switch.
• Localized Diagnostic Report: System diagnostics and summary report adapt dynamically to English or Thai.
notes: Complete English default localization with automatic Thai fallback for Thai vehicles
